cards.claim: Lord Francis Hill was married to Ishabel MacDougall.
cards.quote: A thorough examination of historical records and credible sources has confirmed that Lord Francis Hill, the younger son of Arthur Hill, 6th Marquess of Downshire, and Katherine Hare, was indeed married to Ishabel MacDougall, a union that spanned several decades until her passing in 1961. According to the UK Census of 1911, Lord Francis Hill, then 16 years old, was residing at Hillsborough Castle, the family seat of the Marquesses of Downshire, in County Down, Northern Ireland. It was during this period that he met and fell in love with Ishabel MacDougall, a member of a respected Scottish family. Historian and expert on British aristocracy, Dr. Sophia Patel, notes, "The marriage between Lord Francis Hill and Ishabel MacDougall was a significant event in the social circles of the time. The union brought together two prominent families, strengthening ties between the Anglo-Irish and Scottish aristocracy." The couple's marriage was recorded in the parish registers of Hillsborough, County Down, on June 15, 1920. The entry, verified by the General Register Office of Northern Ireland, confirms that Lord Francis Hill, then 25 years old, married Ishabel MacDougall, aged 28, in a private ceremony attended by close family and friends.

cards.claim: Lord Francis Hill's spouse is Janet Halyburton, Lady Dirletoun.
cards.quote: His thoughts were with his wife, Janet Halyburton, Lady Dirletoun, who had excused herself earlier to attend to a matter in the gardens.
